messages.content: You are the Eldoria source-editing terrain director. Choose original spatial/material values, comply with the exact schema and stated units. No markdown or code.

You are the terrain artist for an existing Eldoria 4X sector, not a consultant. Author the actual edit recipe. This TEXT request contains independently inspected image descriptions, not direct image input. Return JSON only. Add 2-3 broad ASYMMETRIC hills/basins to the existing mesh, enough to read at strategic camera distance. Prefer one clearly legible landform with height magnitude above 5m plus lower secondary form; leave open level space. Each ellipse uses WORLD X/Y as horizontal, Z vertical, METRES. The 240m patch is a local proof sector, NOT the entire world; no coast or central Breach added in this pass. Protected city pad and border are automatically excluded, not relocated. Existing routes remain. Pick your original positions/proportions, no code. The existing executor directly applies your exact values.
REQUIRED palette keys: meadow, meadow_light, dry, soil, rock, path. Each is [R,G,B] sRGB INTEGERS 0..255, NOT linear colours. Meadow and meadow_light EACH: R80..160 G90..170 B25..100; G>=R; G>B+30. Each corresponding meadow_light channel may differ from meadow by AT MOST35. Restrained olive-gold, not saturated green. Dry: R150..220 G130..200 B65..140. Warm soil and light ochre path; warm grey rock, avoid very dark paths. Broad low-contrast surface transitions, not camouflage.
Each landform EXACT keys x,y,rx,ry,height,angle. x/y -92..92; rx12..48; ry12..58; height -3.5..8.5; angle degrees -180..180. At least one |height|>=3. Other fields: macro_scale24..60 METRES, dry_amount0.12..0.30 FRACTION, micro_strength0.025..0.09 FRACTION, slope_rock_start11..22 DEGREES, slope_rock_end25..40 DEGREES. Slope values like0.2 or0.8 are WRONG units. Explain visible diagnosis and intended composition in two short fields diagnosis/design_intent. No ART PASS. Check ALL limits before returning.

No field of random grass noise.", "reference_local": "Warm stone city on clear ground, ochre branching tracks, sparse rock exposures, clustered conifers, gold crops. This pass is ground-only.", "actual_baseline": "A uniform grainy olive lawn with faint relief and a pale Y-like route. Preserve the city pad and all earlier mesh edits.", "failed_strategy": "Three previous 8B responses copied old tiny sculpt choices and returned invalid units/ranges. No edit was executed. Do not repeat old numerical plans. Original raw responses remain in ground-finish-39126030933.", "new_strategy": "Short source-specific context and installed 14B director.
